player_prompt.intro:
D kečč imiraz {player_id}. D kečč tira Guess The Number.
Yessefk ad d-keččeḍ uṭṭun gar {min_number} ed {max_number} deffir {max_turns} n tikwal.
Mi d-kecmeḍ tiririt-ik, irwas-d umazrar ad ak-d-yawi talleltin am 'ɛlayen' neɣ 'addayen'.
Tzemreḍ ad tessutreḍ tiririt-ik s yimdanen meṛṛa. Uṭṭun i yellan deg teɣwaltin kan i yettwali s tiririt-ik. Amedya, [5].
Mi d-keččeḍ, amezruy n tiririyin-ik ad yettwaru ddaw-a. Seqdec tallelt-a akken ad t-fakked umazrar uqbel ad d-keččeḍ tikwal-ik.
Ddu tiririt-ik.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Amasal n tuffɣa ur yelli. Amurar {player_id} ur yirna d akken ilaq '[number]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Aḥric ur nlaq ara. Amyurar {player_id} yeɣḍer-d yiwen uṭṭun beṛṛa i uswir yettwafernen.
invalid_move.already_guessed: Aḥeddad ur nlaq ara. Amyurar {player_id} yeɣḍer yakan uṭṭun-nni.

outcome.turn_limit: Tikelt i d-yettwasemma tedda. Tiririt: {guess}, Iɣil: {target}
